facts.statement: Senior Producer Andy Sites discussed planned summer 2009 additions to Free Realms: racing, demolition derby, soccer and housing.
facts.quote: over the summer - with racing, demolition derby, soccer, and housing

article_summaries.title: The Future of Free Realms - A Video Q&A with Andy Sites
article_summaries.summary: A June 2009 E3 video interview with Free Realms Senior Producer Andy Sites, posted after the April 2009 launch. It reports that the game had passed 2 million players and that summer plans included racing, demolition derby, soccer and housing, plus a new area planned for fall 2009. The page carries only the blurb; the video's spoken content is not in the text, so the planned features are not confirmed as shipped.
